collection.title: Renault 5 1984 to 1996 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Renault 5 1983 - 1989 model requires a 18" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. You have the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit style wiper. We also have the rear wiper blade for this model, simplt click on the Rear Blades tab below.
